text: Public model policy seam is now wired: ModelBuildSpec.missingValuePolicy forwards to EventModelBuilder, and eventsTable no longer rejects non-finite ordinary numeric columns before the explicit policy can interpret them. S06 proves the public path for ZeroContribution, ImputeConstant, DropFromTerm, and explicit Reject failure. P2.2 remains open for ordered orthogonalization, richer degenerate-scope policy, and external R parity fixtures.
